children.notes: Research on cognitive mechanisms behind conspiracy theories by **[Prof. Karen Douglas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Karen_Douglas)**.

Conspiracy theories offer an explanation to cope with intense feelings of **powerlessness** and **disillusionment**.

* See also: [Conspiracy Theories & Psychology](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conspiracy_theory#Psychology)

Narcissistic groups (e.g., *German High Command*) project failure onto external out-groups when reality contradicts their perceived invincibility.

* Related concept: [Collective Narcissism](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Collective_narcissism)
Conspiracy beliefs resist change once established, leading individuals down escalating *'rabbit holes'*.
Neurobiological frameworks from **[Prof. Robert Sapolsky](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Robert_Sapolsky)** (*Behave: The Biology of Humans at Our Best and Worst*).
Processes **fear** and **anger** in split seconds, bypassing slower analytical reasoning in the [frontal cortex](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frontal_lobe).
*'Them and Us'* dichotomizing is an evolutionary survival mechanism far older than humanity itself.
Humans have an innate biological pull to divide people into **'Us'** vs. **'Them'** and view *'Thems'* unfavorably.

Defining an out-group as an inherently dangerous, subhuman, or biologically distinct species.

* Concept: [Pseudospeciation](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pseudospeciation)

Using terms like *'vermin'* or *'filthy'* activates both [insula](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Insular_cortex) and [amygdala](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amygdala), linking out-groups to repulsive physical smells.

Forcing public degradation (e.g., Viennese Jews scrubbing sidewalks) shifts perceived status from *'competent & malevolent'* to *'powerless & malevolent'*

* Framework: [Stereotype Content Model](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stereotype_content_model)

Cognitive tendency to assume that momentous historical disasters (e.g., losing WWI) must have momentous, evil causes.

* See: [Proportionality Bias](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Proportionality_bias)

Language evolved as social grooming; conspiracy theories function as the ultimate hidden secrets.

* Concept: [Grooming, Gossip, and the Evolution of Language](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Grooming,_Gossip,_and_the_Evolution_of_Language)
